description: Find everyone who represents a full street address: the two US Senators and House member (bioguideId, name, party, state, district, chamber) plus every state legislator for the address (name, party, district, chamber, phone, email). The Census Geocoder resolves the exact districts; a ZIP code alone is not accepted because ZIPs cross district lines.

street.description: Street address (e.g., "123 Main St") — required for district-level lookup

name: lookup_representatives
title: Representative lookup by address
